method.frequency: monthly, non-overlapping log changes / asset log returns
method.control: contemporaneous dollar-index log return; partial correlation, not causality
method.seasonalSensitivity: remove full-sample calendar-month means from money/asset/dollar changes; descriptive only
method.interval: 95% circular moving-block bootstrap, 6-month blocks, 600 repetitions, seed 20261008
method.lagPolicy: preselected lags 0/1/3/6 months; common target-month intersection across every lag and both FX methods; no optimized chart shifts; latest revisions do not support an investable forecast
method.prices: same month, last own valid observation within 7 days of month end; US M2 monthly average versus other stocks at month end

liquiditySources.title: 三大经济体 M2 研究组合
liquiditySources.formula_current_fx: US M2 USD + China M2 CNY × USD/CNY + euro-area M2 EUR × USD/EUR
liquiditySources.formula_fixed_fx: same local-currency balances; CNY and EUR exchange rates fixed at 2020-12 last valid trading observation
liquiditySources.period_alignment_limit: US M2 is monthly average; Chinese/ECB M2 are end-month stocks. Same-month alignment is an approximation, not synchronous point-in-time liquidity.
liquiditySources.vintage_limit: Current retrieved revisions, not a historical release-vintage panel. Do not claim an investable historical predictor or optimize a lead/lag.
liquiditySources.comparability_limit: National M2 definitions differ, euro-area membership changes, China M2 statistical scope changed in 2011/2018. Fixed FX removes translation changes only, not local-definition/reclassification effects.
liquiditySources.fx_period_basis: FRED H.10 daily New York noon buying rate, last valid observation of each completed calendar month
liquiditySources.decomposition: YoY symmetric midpoint exact identity, each region Δ(MF)=mean(F)ΔM+mean(M)ΔF; aggregate contributions divided by prior-year dollar total
liquiditySources.missing_policy: no zero fill, no interpolation, no cross-month forward fill; aggregate requires every constituent and same-month FX

method.scope: 美国、中国、欧元区 M2 的研究组合，不等于全球总量；与美元计价黄金比较。
method.change: X_t / X_(t-12) - 1；黄金、两种 M2 篮子和美元指数均使用算术同比。
method.units: fraction；显示百分比时乘 100。相关系数本身无单位。
method.fx: usd 为当期汇率折算；fixed 固定 2020-12 汇率。两个口径使用相同目标月份。
method.control: 控制同期美元指数算术同比；分别对 X/Y 关于截距和美元同比回归后，计算残差的 Pearson 相关。
method.overlapping: 逐月计算 12 个月同比，相邻观测共享 11 个月变化；月份数不代表独立观察数。
method.annual: 预先固定每年 12 月的同比，即上年 12 月至本年 12 月；年度区间互不重叠，但不保证统计独立。
method.prices: 只用已完成月份的自身最后有效价格，距月末不超过 7 天；无插值或跨月填充。美国 M2 月均，中欧 M2 月末，按月近似对齐。
method.sample: 黄金、美元指数、当期与固定汇率 M2 同比的有效月份交集；年度结果仅保留交集中的 12 月。
method.interval: 本补充不新增置信区间，不将重叠同比的样本数当作独立样本数。
method.boundary: 与原研究的非重叠月度对数变化分开；当前修订数据未按历史发布日期回放，相关不是因果、预测或交易信号。
